method: The generator uses only natural C-major notes and writes four quarter notes in each 4/4 measure. Treble exercises span E4-F5 inside the staff or C4-A5 with one neighboring ledger line; bass exercises span G2-A3 inside the staff or E2-C4 with one neighboring ledger line. Steps-only motion moves by one diatonic staff position, mixed motion by one to three positions, and leaps motion by two to four positions in either direction, reversing or choosing another interval at range boundaries. A trimmed seed of 1-48 characters and all settings are hashed with FNV-1a and fed to a Mulberry32-style deterministic pseudorandom generator, so identical inputs reproduce the same melody. The SVG renderer places note heads by diatonic staff position, adds ledger lines where needed and reveals note names only on request. The tool stores nothing, accepts no files, plays no audio and makes no network requests.
